spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence shows background vs. main event correctly?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] Children were playing in the park when the ice cream truck came.
B. [WRONG] Children played in the park when the ice cream truck was coming.
C. [WRONG] Children were playing in the park when the ice cream truck was coming.
D. [WRONG] Children had played in the park when the ice cream truck came.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: Children played in the park when the ice cream truck was coming., Children were playing in the park when the ice cream truck was coming., Children had played in the park when the ice cream truck came.
